title: Galois transitivity on primes of a tensor scalar extension
statement: Let k and K be fields and K/k a possibly infinite Galois extension. Let A be a commutative k-algebra. For any prime-spectrum points x,y of A tensor_k K [def-weil-affine-spectrum] with equal contractions along a maps to a tensor 1, there exists a k-algebra automorphism sigma of K such that comap(id_A tensor sigma)(x)=y. The tensor ring maps are those of [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-tensor-map-ring-hom].

source.place: Algebra.IsInvariant.exists_smul_of_under_eq_of_profinite; tensor invariants as in Stacks Tag 038B

proof.text: Construct the action on the right tensor factor by the monoid homomorphism sigma maps to Algebra.TensorProduct.congr refl sigma. Tensor induction proves openness of stabilizers: zero is fixed by all automorphisms, a pure tensor is fixed by the open stabilizer of its right coefficient, and the intersection of two open stabilizers fixes a sum. Apply continuousSMul_iff_stabilizer_isOpen to the discrete tensor ring. Tensor induction also proves that the action commutes with A-scalars.

proof.text: InfiniteGalois.mem_range_algebraMap_iff_fixed identifies the fixed field of the full Galois group with k. Apply TensorProduct.injective_and_range_eq_invariants to the top subgroup. Its range equality supplies Algebra.IsInvariant A (A tensor K) Gal(K/k).

proof.text: Apply Algebra.IsInvariant.exists_smul_of_under_eq_of_profinite to the two prime ideals, using congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal on the equality of contractions. The resulting equality y.asIdeal = sigma smul x.asIdeal means membership is pulled back by sigma inverse. Choose sigma inverse and use PrimeSpectrum.ext and Ideal.mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem.

theorem exists_comap_eq_of_galois
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] [IsGalois k K]
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (x y : PrimeSpectrum (A ⊗[k] K))
    (hxy : PrimeSpectrum.comap
      (includeLeft : A →ₐ[k] A ⊗[k] K).toRingHom x =
      PrimeSpectrum.comap (includeLeft : A →ₐ[k] A ⊗[k] K).toRingHom y) :
    ∃ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K,
      PrimeSpectrum.comap (map (AlgHom.id k A) σ.toAlgHom).toRingHom x = y
